mapper.select: SELECT * FROM price_import_preview WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_import_preview_row(preview_id,row_number,raw_values,result) VALUES (#{id},#{r.rowNumber},CAST(#{r.raw} AS jsonb),CAST(#{r.result} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT row_number,raw_values::text AS raw_values,result::text AS result FROM price_import_preview_row WHERE preview_id=#{id} ORDER BY row_number LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE price_import_preview SET consumed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
